items.title: Deere (DE) Stock May Be 11% Undervalued As Construction Demand Lifts Outlook
items.summary: Deere stock has almost doubled investor capital over the past five years, yet current valuation checks send mixed messages, with a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to an 11.1% discount while broader metrics lean less generous. Recent news around construction strength, AI focused partnerships and labor negotiations adds extra context to how much of Deere's future cash flow story might already be priced in.
